notes: Generated media remains private and Brand scoped; temporary publishing URLs are bounded egress capabilities only.
The encoder boundary permits one configured FFmpeg executable through direct process invocation only; no shell or user-controlled command grammar.
Prepared media retains Workspace, Brand, exact Content Version, Claim, source fingerprint, object/hash, encoder-version and expiry lineage.
No autonomous publishing, release, deployment or production enablement is authorized.

approvals.rationale: Explicitly approved VS-20 Publishable Creative Media Pipeline scope as defined in the prior proposal.
Approved PRD/TRD private object storage, deterministic publishing, provider-neutral boundaries and Brand isolation already govern this slice.
Bounded runtime implementation explicitly authorized with the instruction to approve and go next.
Final exact candidate requires CI/Security/Product Intake plus SHA-bound human certification.
